confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate, not checked against live prices or listings. Food, coffee and beer anchors sit about 5-18% above the Edinburgh comparable and are the most reliable. Hostel and hotel anchors are less certain (roughly +/-20-25%) because London accommodation varies widely by district, season and booking lead time, and July is peak season. Cocktail and wine rest on a beer-relationship basis rather than direct price knowledge: cocktail is set at about 2.1x the beer anchor and wine at about 1.36x.
comparable_city_reasoning: Edinburgh is the primary comparable (same UK price base and currency). London food, coffee and beer sit about 5-18% above it, the basic hotel about 27% above, the three-star about 10% above, and hostel dorm and private room about 76-77% above. Vienna and Reykjavik bracket the range: Vienna is lower than London on every comparable price point, while Reykjavik is higher on food and drink, roughly level on hostels, and lower on hotels.
